description: The physical business locations behind an Apple Maps brand — the shops, restaurants or service centres an Ads-on-Apple-Maps campaign promotes. Filter by mapsBrandId (do: without it Apple returns every location across every brand, which can be a very large page), plus status, eligibility or address. LOCATIONS ARE READ-ONLY THROUGH THIS API BY APPLE’S DESIGN: Apple Business Connect creates and maintains them, so a missing shop, a wrong address or a closure is fixed there and appears here afterwards — there is no create, update or delete to look for. Only a location with status OPEN and eligibility ELIGIBLE is targetable. You do not target locations directly: collect the ids you want, put them in a location group with create_apple_ads_location_group, then point an ad group at that group. Read-only, free.

adminArea.description: Full state or province name, e.g. "California".

eligibilityStatus.description: Apple eligibility state; only ELIGIBLE locations can be targeted

limit.description: maximum number of locations to return

mapsBrandId.description: Strongly recommended — scopes to one brand.

status.description: Usually OPEN — only OPEN locations are targetable.

name: list_apple_ads_locations
title: List Apple Maps business locations
